title: ResBench: Benchmarking LLM-Generated FPGA Designs with Resource Awareness
abstract: arXiv:2503.08823v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) are widely used in modern hardware design, yet writing Hardware Description Language (HDL) code for FPGA implementation remains a complex and time-consuming task. Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising tool for HDL generation, but existing benchmarks for LLM-based code generation primarily focus on functional correctness while overlooking hardware resource usage. Furthermore, current benchmarks offer limited diversity and do not fully represent the wide range of real-world FPGA applications. To address these shortcomings, we introduce ResBench, the first resource-focused benchmark explicitly designed to distinguish between resource-optimized and inefficient LLM-generated HDL code. ResBench consists of 56 problems across 12 categories, covering applications from finite state machines to financial computing. Our open-source evaluation framework automatically tests LLMs by g

translated_title: ResBench：面向资源感知的大语言模型生成FPGA设计基准测试
translated_abstract: 现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）在现代硬件设计中被广泛使用，但为FPGA实现编写硬件描述语言（HDL）代码仍然是一项复杂且耗时的任务。大语言模型（LLM）已成为HDL生成的一种有前景的工具，但现有的LLM代码生成基准主要关注功能正确性，而忽略了硬件资源的使用情况。此外，当前的基准多样性有限，未能充分覆盖现实世界中广泛的FPGA应用。为了解决这些不足，我们提出了ResBench，这是首个专注于资源的基准，旨在明确区分资源优化与低效的LLM生成HDL代码。ResBench包含12个类别共56个问题，涵盖从有限状态机到金融计算等多种应用。我们的开源评估框架通过…（原文在此处截断）自动测试大语言模型。
tldr: ResBench是首个关注FPGA硬件资源效率的LLM代码生成基准，通过12个类别共56个问题评估LLM生成的HDL代码，弥补了现有基准只关注功能正确性而忽视资源使用的不足。
en_tdlr: ResBench is the first resource-focused benchmark with 56 problems across 12 categories that evaluates LLM-generated HDL code for FPGA designs, distinguishing resource-optimized implementations from inefficient ones beyond mere functional correctness.
